lines.en: label dojo35:
scene ayanedojothreefive1
I make my way through a crowd of girls practicing roundhouse kicks or something.
lines.zh: 我穿过一群正在练什么回旋踢的女孩。

lines.en: Actually, I can't even tell what kind of kick it is.
lines.zh: 其实我根本看不出那是哪种踢法。

lines.en: I feel like I should probably pay more attention in this class if I’m going to start calling moves and techniques by their proper names.
lines.zh: 我觉得，既然要把招式和技巧叫对名字，我大概该在这门课上更认真一点。

lines.en: Anyway-
lines.zh: 总之——

lines.en: I make my way through a crowd of girls doing indiscernible karate kick things and find Ayane pressed up against a wall in the back half of the dojo.
lines.zh: 我穿过一群做着分辨不出的空手道踢腿动作的女孩，发现 Ayane 贴在道场后半边的墙上。

lines.en: The sun must be feeling particularly feisty today as it leaps in through the window and reminds us that, even in winter, it is a giant, vicious ball of fire.
lines.zh: 今天的太阳一定格外亢奋，它从窗口一跃而入，提醒着我们：即便在冬天，它依然是一颗巨大而凶残的火球。

lines.en: : So...you came after all...
lines.zh: : 所以……你终究还是来了……

lines.en: Wind blows in through the window and misses Ayane’s hair by an inch or two.
lines.zh: 风从窗口吹进来，差一两英寸就拂到了 Ayane 的头发。

lines.en: I decide to mention it anyway, though, because I feel like I’m going to have to set the stage for what I imagine will be another roleplaying session.
lines.zh: 不过我还是决定提一嘴，因为我觉得，接下来大概又是一场角色扮演，我得先把舞台搭好。

lines.en: : Amamiya! Are you doing anything today or are you just going to sit there?!
lines.zh: : Amamiya！你今天到底要不要动一动，还是就打算一直坐在那儿？！

lines.en: : Do you know what day today is, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你知道今天是什么日子吗？

lines.en: else:
: Sunday.
lines.zh: : 星期天。

lines.en: : Not just Sunday.
lines.zh: : 不只是星期天。

lines.en: : It’s the anniversary of our fated first encounter under the world tree.
lines.zh: : 今天是我们宿命般地在世界树下初次相遇的纪念日。

lines.en: : There’s a world tree now?
lines.zh: : 现在还有世界树了？

lines.en: scene ayanedojothreefive2
: Oh, right...you lost your memories after retreating to the mountains and overworking yourself to the point of amnesia.
lines.zh: : 哦，对……你退隐到山里，把自己操劳到失忆，然后就把记忆弄丢了。

lines.en: No, I was just reincarnated.
lines.zh: 不，我只是转生了而已。

lines.en: Probably.
lines.zh: 大概吧。

lines.en: : But that’s fine...I’m already shouldering some of the world’s greatest secrets.
lines.zh: : 不过没关系……我已经替这个世界扛下了不少最大的秘密。

lines.en: : One more will not do me in.
lines.zh: : 再多一个也压不垮我。

lines.en: scene ayanedojothreefive3
: Just know...this is an important day for both of us.
lines.zh: : 你只要知道……今天对我们两个都很重要。

lines.en: : And the fact that I must live through it each and every year on my own is tearing me up inside.
lines.zh: : 而我每年都必须独自熬过这一天，这件事正把我从内到外撕碎。

lines.en: : Are you crying?
lines.zh: : 你在哭？

lines.en: : Yes, but only in character. I’m fine otherwise.
lines.zh: : 是的，但只是入戏而已。其他方面我很好。

lines.en: : You’re a surprisingly good actress.
lines.zh: : 你演得出乎意料地好。

lines.en: scene ayanedojothreefive4
: Thank you!
lines.zh: : 谢谢！

lines.en: : Ami and I used to have fake battles in her bedroom while you were out doing Sensei stuff, so I got a lot of practice in then.
lines.zh: : 你出去忙 Sensei 那些事的时候，我和 Ami 常在她的卧室里打假想战，所以那时候练了不少。

lines.en: scene ayanedojothreefive5
: At least give me a fucking answer, come on!
lines.zh: : 起码给我个他妈的回答吧，拜托！

lines.en: : What happened to the two of you who were fighting to keep this place open?
lines.zh: : 当初为了保住这个地方而奋斗的你们两个，到底怎么了？

lines.en: : Was it really all so you could just sit around and stare at each other all day?
lines.zh: : 你们拼成那样，难道就为了能整天坐着互相干瞪眼？

lines.en: : Sitting around and staring at Sensei is far more important to me than karate lessons.
lines.zh: : 对我来说，坐着盯着 Sensei 看，可比空手道课重要多了。

lines.en: : Besides, I’m not feeling well today.
lines.zh: : 再说了，我今天不太舒服。

lines.en: scene ayanedojothreefive6
: Again?
lines.zh: : 又来？

lines.en: : This is like the third weekend in a row.
lines.zh: : 这都连续第三个周末了。

lines.en: : On the bright side, I still showed up to see your beautiful face!
lines.zh: : 往好处想，我这不是还来见你这张漂亮的脸了吗！

lines.en: : Flattery won’t earn you a belt, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 光靠奉承可拿不到腰带，Ayane。

lines.en: : If you want to get serious about this like you said, you’re going to have to actually start putting in the time.
lines.zh: : 如果你真像自己说的那样想认真练，就得真正开始投入时间。

lines.en: : I know, I know. And I will soon, I promise.
lines.zh: : 我知道，我知道。我很快就会的，我保证。

lines.en: : Also, what the hell is with that posture? At least sit up straight if you’re going to be taking {i}another{/i} day off.
lines.zh: : 还有，你那姿势到底算什么？既然又要{i}再{/i}休息一天，至少给我坐直了。

lines.en: scene ayanedojothreefive7
: No can do, Sensei...I have to sit this way or I won’t look cool. It’s half the reason my monologue succeeded.
lines.zh: : 这可办不到，Sensei……我非得这么坐，不然就不够帅。我的独白能成功有一半是这个原因。

lines.en: : I know Osako is the instructor, but please don’t call her “Sensei.” It is needlessly confusing for me.
lines.zh: : 我知道 Osako 是教练，但请别叫她「 Sensei」。这对我造成了不必要的混乱。

lines.en: scene ayanedojothreefive8
: Are {i}you{/i} the reason she’s sitting out over and over again? Because I have no problem kicking you out of here for doing...literally nothing at any point ever.
lines.zh: : 她一次又一次地缺席，该不会是{i}你{/i}的缘故吧？我可一点都不介意把你轰出去，毕竟你……从头到尾真的什么都没干过。

lines.en: : I’ll take you on right now, Osako.
lines.zh: : 我现在就跟你打，Osako。

lines.en: : I have to fight naked, though. It’s part of Arakawa family tradition.
lines.zh: : 不过我得脱光了打。那是我们 Arakawa 家的传统。

lines.en: : Ahh yes, {i}crouching sausage style.{/i} One I’m all too familiar with.
lines.zh: : 啊，对，{i}伏香肠式{/i}。我可对它再熟悉不过了。

lines.en: scene ayanedojothreefive9
: Yeah...I bet you are.
lines.zh: : 是啊……我猜也是。

lines.en: : Hahah...hah...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……哈……

lines.en: : Ayane will start practicing again next session. Just take it easy on her today.
lines.zh: : Ayane 下次课就会重新开始练了。今天你就放过她吧。

lines.en: : She’s still getting over how I lost my memory when I went into the mountains to-
lines.zh: : 她还没缓过来呢，毕竟我进山的时候把记忆弄丢了，然后——

lines.en: scene ayanedojothreefive10
: Leave and never come back.
lines.zh: : 一去不回。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, who are you again? I lost my memory and can’t seem to remember your-
lines.zh: : 不好意思，你又是谁来着？我失忆了，怎么也想不起你的——

lines.en: : I’m the woman who is going to end your life.
lines.zh: : 我就是那个要终结你性命的女人。

lines.en: : At least give your girlfriend that sweet release first. She’s been asking for it ever since I met her.
lines.zh: : 至少先给你女朋友那种甜美的解脱吧。自我认识她起，她就一直在要。

lines.en: scene ayanedojothreefive11
: Wha- Never mention Wakana and “sweet release” in the same sentence again or I really {i}will{/i} end your life!
lines.zh: : 什——别再把 Wakana 和「甜美的解脱」放在同一句话里说，否则我真的{i}会{/i}要你的命！

lines.en: : Don’t worry. I only fantasize about you two on occasion. It doesn’t happen every night.
lines.zh: : 别担心。我只是偶尔幻想一下你们两个而已。又不是每晚都这样。

lines.en: : Don’t fantasize about us ever!
lines.zh: : 永远都别幻想我们！

lines.en: : I can’t help it. That’s just the way I am, unfortunately.
lines.zh: : 我忍不住。很遗憾，我就是这样的人。

lines.en: scene ayanedojothreefive12
: Whatever. Just don’t be expecting another invite out anytime soon.
lines.zh: : 随便吧。只是近期别指望再被邀请出去了。

lines.en: : But we had so much fun.
lines.zh: : 可我们玩得很开心啊。

lines.en: : Fuck off. Goodbye.
lines.zh: : 滚蛋。再见。

lines.en: scene ayanedojothreefive13
Osako storms off and-
lines.zh: Osako 气冲冲地走开了，然后——

lines.en: : Did you go out with our karate instructor recently?
lines.zh: : 你最近和我们的空手道教练出去过？

lines.en: And Ayane wastes no time getting to the interrogation that was sure to spring up as a result of that.
lines.zh: 而 Ayane 毫不迟疑地开始了那场必然会由此引发的审问。

lines.en: : It was just a spur of the moment thing.
lines.zh: : 只是一时兴起而已。

lines.en: : She and Wakana were leaving[school] together and they invited Maya and me to come get coffee with them.
lines.zh: : 她和 Wakana 一起离开[school]的时候，邀请了我和 Maya 去跟她们喝咖啡。

lines.en: scene ayanedojothreefive14
: Maya was there too? But wouldn’t that make it kind of like a...double date?
lines.zh: : Maya 也在？那岂不是有点像……双重约会？

lines.en: : With anyone other than Maya, sure. She only came because she was hungry.
lines.zh: : 换成 Maya 以外的任何人，确实是。她只是因为饿了才去的。

lines.en: scene ayanedojothreefive15
: Well...okay. That does check out.
lines.zh: : 嗯……好吧。这倒说得通。

lines.en: : She’s kind of an abyss when it comes to food.
lines.zh: : 在吃这方面，她简直是个无底洞。

lines.en: : That aside, though...what’s going on with you?
lines.zh: : 不过撇开这个……你最近怎么了？

lines.en: scene ayanedojothreefive16
: With me? What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 我怎么了？你是什么意思？

lines.en: : Didn’t I already tell you that I’m grieving over having to spend our anniversary alone?
lines.zh: : 我不是说过了吗，我正在为我们不得不独自度过纪念日而悲伤。

lines.en: : Were you grieving the apparent last several times you’ve sat out training as well?
lines.zh: : 你之前那几次明显坐在一边不训练的时候，也是在悲伤吗？

lines.en: : I’ve just been tired.
lines.zh: : 我只是很累。

lines.en: : That’s been happening a lot lately, though.
lines.zh: : 可最近这种情况发生得太频繁了。

lines.en: : You didn’t show up to the end of the dorm war. And you passed out extremely early the last time you slept over my place with Ami.
lines.zh: : 宿舍大战的最后你没出现。上一次你和 Ami 在我家过夜的时候，你也早早地就昏睡过去了。

lines.en: scene ayanedojothreefive17
: What are you getting at, exactly?
lines.zh: : 你到底想说什么？

lines.en: : I just want to know if everything is okay.
lines.zh: : 我只是想知道你是不是一切都好。

lines.en: : You’re worried about me?
lines.zh: : 你在担心我？

lines.en: : I mean, I didn’t want to come out and say it. But yeah. Of course.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我本来不想说破的。不过是啊。当然是。

lines.en: : One or two times would be fine. In fact, it {i}was{/i} fine. But this whole karate thing on top of that is just a pretty big red flag for me to think something’s actually going on.
lines.zh: : 一两次倒没什么。事实上，之前{i}也确实{/i}没什么。可再加上空手道这整件事，对我来说就是个相当大的危险信号，让我觉得你真的出了什么事。

lines.en: scene ayanedojothreefive18
: Well...thank you for your concern. But I haven’t really figured out a good way to talk about it yet.
lines.zh: : 嗯……谢谢你的关心。不过我还没想出什么好办法来谈这件事。

lines.en: : You already know that I’m pretty bad when it comes to stuff like this, so I guess I’ve just been coasting on secret girl powers to get by.
lines.zh: : 你知道的，我一向不擅长这种事，所以我想我一直都在靠「秘密女生能力」混日子。

lines.en: : Secret...what now?
lines.zh: : 秘密……什么？

lines.en: scene ayanedojothreefive19
: A hidden technique every girl is born with!
lines.zh: : 每个女孩与生俱来的隐藏技！

lines.en: : The option to get out of stuff by blaming it on not feeling well!
lines.zh: : 就是靠一句「身体不舒服」把事情全推掉的选项！

lines.en: : Want to get out of gym class? Say you’re on your period! Don’t want to go hang out with your friends? Period again!
lines.zh: : 想逃体育课？说你来月经了！不想跟朋友出去玩？还是来月经！

lines.en: My mind immediately jumps to the several times girls have dodged having sex with me for reasons related to that and I suddenly lose trust in everyone.
lines.zh: 我立刻想起有好几次，女孩们用相关的理由躲掉了和我上床，于是我对所有人一下子失去了信任。

lines.en: Nowhere is safe anymore.
lines.zh: 再没有哪个地方是安全的了。

lines.en: : That’s evil.
lines.zh: : 太邪恶了。

lines.en: scene ayanedojothreefive20
: It’s not evil. It’s just a way for us to take advantage of our cuteness and gain some kind of benefit in the process.
lines.zh: : 才不邪恶。那只是我们利用自己可爱、顺带捞点好处的方式罢了。

lines.en: : Yeah, well, I’m pretty sure people are going to catch on if you’ve been blaming your lack of participation on your period for several months straight.
lines.zh: : 是吗，不过我敢肯定，要是你连着好几个月都把不参加活动推到月经头上，人家迟早会看穿的。

lines.en: scene ayanedojothreefive21
: Uhh...well, all I said is that I wasn’t feeling well. So it was kind of a gray area.
lines.zh: : 呃……那个，我说的只是「不太舒服」而已。所以算是灰色地带吧。

lines.en: : But you’re right. I should stop trying to get the world to revolve around me and only take advantage of secret girl powers once a week at most.
lines.zh: : 不过你是对的。我不该再想着让世界围着我转了，以后「秘密女生能力」最多一周用一次。

lines.en: : You know, that wasn’t really the lesson I was trying to teach you, but I’m glad that you at least got something out of it.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我想教的其实不是这个，不过很高兴你多少还是学到了点东西。

lines.en: scene ayanedojothreefive20
: Since I can’t turn back on using my power today, though, does this mean you’ll hang out with me and protect me if Osako tries to roundhouse kick my head off?
lines.zh: : 不过既然我今天已经用了这个能力、没法反悔，那是不是意味着你会陪着我，要是在 Osako 想把我的头用回旋踢踢飞的时候保护我？

lines.en: A-ha. So it {i}was{/i} called a roundhouse kick.
lines.zh: 啊哈。原来那{i}真的{/i}叫回旋踢。

lines.en: : Sure.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure everyone in the dojo already assumes that you and I are-
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定，道场里的所有人早都以为你和我是——

lines.en: : In love?
lines.zh: : 在相爱？

lines.en: : In{i}volved{/i}.
lines.zh: : 有{i}一腿{/i}。

lines.en: : Call it love. I want to hear you say you love me.
lines.zh: : 就说是爱吧。我想听你说你爱我。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Because you barely ever say “love” and I could really use the pick me up right about now.
lines.zh: : 因为你几乎从来不说「爱」这个字，而我现在正需要有人给我打打气。

lines.en: : I can wait all day. I hope you know this.
lines.zh: : 我可以等一整天。这点你最好搞清楚。

lines.en: : Fine. Whatever. I love you.
lines.zh: : 好吧。随便了。我爱你。

lines.en: scene ayanedojothreefive22
: Heheh~! I love you too!
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿～！我也爱你！

lines.en: : Now come sit next to me and let me rest my head on you so I don’t have to hold this weird sitting pose thingy anymore.
lines.zh: : 那现在过来坐我旁边，让我把头靠在你身上，这样我就不用再维持这个奇怪的坐姿了。

lines.en: scene black
Ayane straightens herself out and slides over a few inches so that she’s not in direct sunlight anymore.
lines.zh: Ayane 把身子坐正，往旁边挪了几英寸，好让自己不再被阳光直射。

lines.en: I take my place beside her and, before I can even open my mouth, she cuddles up against me in complete disregard for the stigma surrounding public displays of affection.
lines.zh: 我在她身边坐下，还没来得及开口，她就完全无视公开秀恩爱会招来的非议，整个人贴了过来。

lines.en: scene ayanedojothreefive23
: Hello, sir. Could I interest you in a horny blonde girl who wants to jerk you off in the bathroom right now?
lines.zh: : 您好，先生。不知您有没有兴趣来一个发情的金发女孩，她现在就想在洗手间里帮您打一发？

lines.en: : What happened to not feeling well?
lines.zh: : 你不是说不舒服吗？

lines.en: : Teacher time is the cure for everything.
lines.zh: : 老师时间是包治百病的良药。

lines.en: : For the last time-
lines.zh: : 我最后说一次——

lines.en: scene ayanedojothreefive24
: I’m kidding.
lines.zh: : 我开玩笑的。

lines.en: : Well, mostly.
lines.zh: : 嗯，大部分是吧。

lines.en: : To be honest, I’d be okay with doing anything with you whenever you want. Wherever you want.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我随时都愿意和你做任何事。在哪都行。

lines.en: : But right now isn’t the time.
lines.zh: : 不过现在不是时候。

lines.en: : Unless you want it to be, I mean.
lines.zh: : 当然，如果你想的话就另当别论。

lines.en: : Cause if you want it to be-
lines.zh: : 因为如果你想的话——

lines.en: : I’m fine right now, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我现在很好，Ayane。

lines.en: : Osako is already keeping an eye on us. I’m pretty sure if we both went to the bathroom at the same time, she’d understand exactly what’s going on.
lines.zh: : Osako 已经在盯着我们了。我敢肯定，要是我们两个同时去洗手间，她立刻就明白是怎么回事了。

lines.en: : True, but I already told you I saw her making out with Ms. Watabe once. So maybe we could make it one of those “eye for an eye” thingies?
lines.zh: : 说的也是，可我跟你说过，我有一次撞见她和 Watabe 老师在亲热。所以也许我们可以来个「以眼还眼」什么的？

lines.en: : You seem pretty desperate right now.
lines.zh: : 你现在看起来挺饥渴的。

lines.en: : Hormones are evil.
lines.zh: : 荷尔蒙真是邪恶。

lines.en: : As soon as we touched heads, I started thinking about kissing. And then kissing made me think about touching. And then touching led to sex. And then sex led to more kissing.
lines.zh: : 我们头一碰在一起，我就开始想接吻。然后接吻又让我想到抚摸。然后抚摸就变成了做爱。然后做爱又变回更多的接吻。

lines.en: : Now I’m going round and round and round and round and I’m going to have to change my underwear soon.
lines.zh: : 现在我脑子里一圈又一圈地转个不停，再过一会儿我就得换内裤了。

lines.en: scene ayanedojothreefive25
: What can I do to make you want me more?
lines.zh: : 我要怎么做，才能让你更想要我？

lines.en: : What do you mean exactly?
lines.zh: : 你具体是什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean that...pretty soon I...
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……很快我……

lines.en: : I might want a lot more attention than I’m currently getting.
lines.zh: : 我可能会想要比现在多得多的关注。

lines.en: : So I’m...looking for tips, I guess.
lines.zh: : 所以……我想找你讨点诀窍吧。

lines.en: : And I’m assuming that’s why you jumped straight to the horny talk?
lines.zh: : 我猜那就是你刚才直奔色情话题的原因？

lines.en: scene ayanedojothreefive26
: Oh, no. That was just me making casual conversation.
lines.zh: : 哦，不是。那只是我在随便闲聊而已。

lines.en: : If sex drive was all it took to convince you to be with me more, we’d be on our honeymoon in Hawaii right now.
lines.zh: : 要是光靠性欲就能让你多陪陪我，我们这会儿早就在夏威夷度蜜月了。

lines.en: : I don't know if you've realized this, but I love your penis almost as much as I love you.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你有没有意识到，我爱你那根鸡巴，几乎和爱你一样多。

lines.en: : I can’t just give you tips on how to steal my attention away from the others, Ayane. It doesn’t really work that way.
lines.zh: : 我可没法教你怎么把我的注意力从别人身上抢走，Ayane。事情不是这么运作的。

lines.en: : I know, but...let’s pretend it {i}does{/i} work that way for a second.
lines.zh: : 我知道，不过……我们就假装它{i}真的{/i}是这么运作的，就一会儿。

lines.en: : You’re in a room with all twenty of us and you can only choose one to spend the rest of forever with.
lines.zh: : 你和我们整整二十个人待在一个房间里，而你只能选一个，和她共度余生。

lines.en: : This hypothetical situation is already flawed because Yumi would not show up for that.
lines.zh: : 这个假设从一开始就站不住脚，因为 Yumi 根本不会来。

lines.en: : Okay, so you’re in a room with nineteen of us and Yumi isn’t there.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那就是你和我们十九个人待在一个房间里，Yumi 不在。

lines.en: : Io probably wouldn’t show up either.
lines.zh: : Io 大概也不会来。

lines.en: : So there are eighteen girls in the room and-
lines.zh: : 那就是房间里还有十八个女孩，然后——

lines.en: : And if Io wasn’t there, Uta would probably be out looking for her and-
lines.zh: : 而要是 Io 不在，Uta 大概会跑出去找她，然后——

lines.en: scene ayanedojothreefive27
: Can I just finish, please?
lines.zh: : 能让我把话说完吗，拜托？

lines.en: : Sorry, go ahead.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，请继续。

lines.en: : If you were in a room with...pretty much every girl you know and had to choose only one of them...
lines.zh: : 如果你和一个房间里……差不多是你认识的每一个女孩待在一起，而你必须只选其中一个……

lines.en: : Is there anything I could do to stand out a little more?
lines.zh: : 有什么是我能做的，能让我更突出一点吗？

lines.en: : You’re not going to just ask me who I would pick?
lines.zh: : 你就不直接问我会选谁吗？

lines.en: : Of course not. I’m afraid of what I’d hear.
lines.zh: : 当然不问。我怕听到答案。

lines.en: : I know you love me...and {i}everyone{/i} knows I love you..but I feel like there might still be more I can do to show it or...
lines.zh: : 我知道你爱我……{i}每个人{/i}都知道我爱你，可我还是觉得，也许我还能再做点什么来表达，或者……

lines.en: : You do more than enough.
lines.zh: : 你已经做得够多了。

lines.en: : Don’t even waste your time thinking about that. There’s no point to it.
lines.zh: : 这种事你连想都别想。根本没意义。

lines.en: : There kind of is, though...
lines.zh: : 可还是有点意义的……

lines.en: : Like...I get that some of the other girls might {i}want{/i} you, but...
lines.zh: : 比如说……我明白其他一些女孩也许{i}想要{/i}你，可是……

lines.en: : But you {i}need{/i} me?
lines.zh: : 但你{i}需要{/i}我？

lines.en: scene ayanedojothreefive28
: Yeah.
: Pretty...{i}pretty{/i} badly...
lines.zh: : 非常……{i}非常{/i}需要……

lines.en: : Don’t you think you should be giving yourself a little more credit?
lines.zh: : 你不觉得你该多给自己一点信心吗？

lines.en: : You’re independent and smart and...can do basically anything you set your mind to.
lines.zh: : 你独立又聪明，而且……基本上只要下定决心，什么都做得到。

lines.en: : This isn’t about {i}me{/i}.
lines.zh: : 这跟{i}我{/i}无关。

lines.en: : Well, if it’s about me-
lines.zh: : 那如果是关于我的话——

lines.en: scene ayanedojothreefive29
: A-Actually! Let’s just change the topic completely.
lines.zh: : 那、那个！我们干脆彻底换个话题吧。

lines.en: : This isn’t really the best place to get all serious and...and I think things were going in a weird direction anyway.
lines.zh: : 这里实在不是个适合谈正经事的地方，而且……而且我觉得刚才的话题本来就越跑越偏了。

lines.en: : This is...exactly why I don’t really like talking about this kind of stuff unless I have to...
lines.zh: : 这就是……为什么除非万不得已，我真的很不喜欢谈这种事……

lines.en: : Soooooo...could I interest you in a horny blonde girl who wants to jerk you off in the bathroom right now?
lines.zh: : 那——么……不知您有没有兴趣来一个发情的金发女孩，她现在就想在洗手间里帮您打一发？

lines.en: : You already used that line.
lines.zh: : 这句台词你已经用过了。

lines.en: scene ayanedojothreefive30
: And you’ve already used {i}me{/i}, but it hasn’t made you any less “excited” whenever we do it.
lines.zh: : 而{i}我{/i}你也都已经用过了，可每次我们做的时候，你也没因此少「兴奋」半分啊。

lines.en: : Some stuff is made to be reused, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 有些东西本来就是拿来重复用的，Sensei。

lines.en: : Just look at your clothes. You wear the same thing every day and I don’t love you any less for it.
lines.zh: : 就拿你的衣服来说。你每天都穿同一套，我也没有因此少爱你一分。

lines.en: : I have two completely different outfits, thank you very much.
lines.zh: : 我可是有两套完全不同的衣服，多谢关心。

lines.en: scene ayanedojothreefive31
: And they’re both adorable!
lines.zh: : 而且两套都可爱极了！

lines.en: : But if we’re not going to complain about reusing our clothes or our bodies, don’t you think it’d be okay to reuse some lines?
lines.zh: : 可既然我们不介意重复使用衣服或者身体，那重复用几句台词又有什么不行？

lines.en: : Like, if that wasn’t the case, we would have only been able to exchange “I love you’s” one time and that would not be nearly enough for my gigantic, Sensei shaped heart.
lines.zh: : 比如说，要不是这样，我们这辈子就只能说一次「我爱你」，而那对我这颗巨大的、Sensei 形状的心来说，远远不够。

lines.en: : If there is anything even remotely resembling me inside of you, we should rush you to the hospital immediately. That is entirely abnormal and you require immediate surgery.
lines.zh: : 要是你体内真有什么东西长得哪怕有一丁点像我，我们得立刻把你送进医院。那完全不正常，你需要马上动手术。

lines.en: : Nope! It being shaped that way lets me fit more of you inside of me than it would normally and-
lines.zh: : 才不！它长成那个形状，反而能让我把更多的你装进身体里，而且——

lines.en: scene ayanedojothreefive32
: Heh.
: {i}Fit more of you inside of me.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}把更多的你装进身体里。{/i}

lines.en: : I wasn’t even trying to make that one dirty. It just happened on its own.
lines.zh: : 那句我根本没想开黄腔。它自己就变成那样了。

lines.en: : You have a problem.
lines.zh: : 你有问题。

lines.en: : I do.
lines.zh: : 我是有问题。

lines.en: : A big Sensei shaped problem.
lines.zh: : 一个大大的、Sensei 形状的问题。

lines.en: : But I wouldn’t trade it for the world.
lines.zh: : 但给我全世界我也不换。

lines.en: scene black
The rest of the afternoon proceeds normally.
lines.zh: 那个下午余下的时间一切如常。

lines.en: There are no more immediate or sudden tonal jumps in conversation and Ayane and I manage to make it through yet another lesson without exerting any energy whatsoever.
lines.zh: 对话里再没有那种突如其来的急转直下，我和 Ayane 也总算又一节课下来，一点力气都没花。

lines.en: However-
lines.zh: 不过——

lines.en: I couldn’t shake the idea of there being something looming in the background.
lines.zh: 我始终甩不掉那个念头——有什么东西正隐隐地悬在背景里。

$ dojo35 = True
{i}Ayane’s affection has increased to [ayane_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Ayane 的好感度提升到了 [ayane_love]!{/i}
